TAXONOMY_NOT_HIERARCHICAL.hint: Create the term without a parent.

MENU_LOCATION_TAKEN.hint: Clear the location from the other menu first, or edit that menu.

MENU_NAME_TAKEN.message: A menu already has this name.

MENU_CYCLE.message: An item cannot be placed under itself or under one of its own sub-items.

MENU_ITEM_INVALID.message: This menu item is not valid.
MENU_ITEM_INVALID.hint: Check its type and destination: an https://, mailto: or tel: address, a path such as /contact, or a content picked from the list.

assist.moderateInlineButton: Check whether a review is needed

entryEdit.schedulePast: Choose a date and time in the future: a publication cannot be scheduled in the past.

visibility.passwordRequired: Enter the password to ask visitors for: the “Apply” button then becomes available.

versions.formattingOnly: The text is identical; only the formatting (list, bold, link…) changed.

done.approved: Comment approved: it is now visible on the site.

menus.created: Menu “{{name}}” created. Now add items to it.
menus.urlInvalid: Enter a valid address: a link starting with https://, mailto: or tel:, or a site path such as /contact. Addresses without a protocol and spaces are not accepted.
menus.entryRequired: Pick the content this item points to from the list below.
menus.termRequired: Pick the term this item points to from the list below.
menus.deleteMenuBody: The menu and all its items will be deleted. If the site shows it at a location, that location stays empty until another menu is assigned to it.

forms.description: Create a contact, sign-up or request form: it is published on a page of your site, without a line of code.
forms.fieldNameHelp: Used as the address of the form's page (for example “contact” gives /forms/contact). Filled in from the label.
forms.notifyChannelsHelp: One channel per line, as channel:recipient (for example slack:#contact). The channel must be set up first under “Channels”.
forms.redirectToHelp: A page of the site (for example /thanks) to send the visitor to after a successful submission, instead of the confirmation message.
forms.rowLabelMissing: Field no. {{position}} has no label: give it a name the visitor will see (for example “Your email”).
forms.rowKindMissing: Choose the type of field no. {{position}} (“{{label}}”).
forms.rowChoicesMissing: Field no. {{position}} (“{{label}}”) offers choices: enter them, separated by commas.

editorFields.name: Technical name (optional)
editorFields.step: Step (leave empty for a single page)

formSubmissions.gdprEraseTitle: Erase every submission from this person?
formSubmissions.gdprEraseBody: Every submission that mentions the address “{{email}}” will be permanently erased, whatever the form. This cannot be undone.

media.uploadImageTypes: Accepted images: {{types}} (the file's content is checked, not its extension). Any other file, such as a PDF, is accepted and offered as a download.
media.uploadDropHint: or drop files anywhere on this page

calendar.nothingThisPeriod: Nothing scheduled or published this month.

trash.neverSweptYet: The automatic trash clean-up has not run yet since the site started.
